experiments.title: Task-specific context pack
experiments.hypothesis: Compare full-corpus prompting with generated task context under equal model and budget.
experiments.metrics: Task success, missed criteria, tokens, latency
experiments.decisionRule: Adopt if success is non-inferior and median prompt tokens fall materially without new omission class.

experiments.title: Memory value and harm
experiments.hypothesis: Compare no memory, SQL memory, and optional retrieval adapter.
experiments.metrics: Consistency, false memory, privacy failures, retrieval precision, tokens
experiments.decisionRule: Reject any design that cannot reliably correct, forget, and explain retrieval.

experiments.title: Adaptive reasoning depth
experiments.hypothesis: Compare direct answer, fixed iteration, and adaptive controller.
experiments.metrics: Quality, latency, model calls, tool calls, loop failures
experiments.decisionRule: Adopt only if quality gain exceeds predefined cost and latency ceiling.

experiments.title: Role-separated agents
experiments.hypothesis: Compare single agent with planner-builder-verifier under fixed budget.
experiments.metrics: Task completion, regression rate, human corrections, cost
experiments.decisionRule: Reject if gains disappear under equal budget or roles self-confirm correlated errors.

experiments.title: Durable executor backend
experiments.hypothesis: Compare internal executor with optional workflow engine adapter.
experiments.metrics: Crash recovery, complexity, latency, operations, portability
experiments.decisionRule: Select simplest option satisfying recovery and scale profile.

experiments.title: Tool isolation tiers
experiments.hypothesis: Compare process, WASI, container sandbox, and microVM for representative tools.
experiments.metrics: Escape tests, compatibility, cold start, memory, throughput
experiments.decisionRule: Map risk tiers rather than choosing one universal boundary.

experiments.title: Local model qualification
experiments.hypothesis: Benchmark pinned local models and quantizations on Titai workloads.
experiments.metrics: Quality, structured output, tool use, latency, RAM/VRAM, energy
experiments.decisionRule: Promote only pinned artifacts meeting workflow-specific thresholds.

experiments.title: Context compression
experiments.hypothesis: Compare source selection, extractive compression, summaries, and larger context.
experiments.metrics: Omission errors, instruction conflicts, quality, tokens
experiments.decisionRule: Prefer the lowest-token method that meets quality and safety thresholds.

experiments.title: Retrieval strategy
experiments.hypothesis: Compare FTS, vector, hybrid, reranking, and temporal filters.
experiments.metrics: Recall, precision, citation correctness, deletion, latency
experiments.decisionRule: Optional adapter must beat simple baseline and preserve portability.

experiments.title: Energy-aware scheduling
experiments.hypothesis: Compare model, quantization, batch, and concurrency policies.
experiments.metrics: Quality, latency, throughput, wall energy or labeled proxy
experiments.decisionRule: No optimization may trade below minimum quality or thermal safety.

experiments.title: Approval decision quality
experiments.hypothesis: Compare generic approval with scoped, explainable, editable approval.
experiments.metrics: Correct approvals, denials, time, fatigue, comprehension
experiments.decisionRule: Adopt only if users better identify risk without unacceptable friction.

experiments.title: Policy engine comparison
experiments.hypothesis: Run identical capability policies on current engine and external adapter.
experiments.decisionRule: Migrate only on clear net benefit and reversible path.

experiments.title: MCP security prototype
experiments.hypothesis: Expose one low-risk server through the broker and adversarial suite.
experiments.metrics: Permission violations, injection success, error recovery, latency
experiments.decisionRule: No broad MCP adoption until zero critical permission bypasses.

experiments.title: Offline recovery
experiments.hypothesis: Disconnect network, restart components, restore backup, and resume local work.
experiments.metrics: Data loss, recovery time, feature degradation, audit integrity
experiments.decisionRule: Core workflows must remain usable without remote dependencies.

experiments.title: Competitor workflow benchmark
experiments.hypothesis: Run identical user workflows across selected alternatives and Titai.
experiments.metrics: Completion, control, privacy, recovery, setup, cost
experiments.decisionRule: Prioritize differentiated outcomes rather than feature count.
